messages:
maya: Thinking out loud  partners want to route some traffic to a low-latency dedicated pool using only headers (no auth changes). idea: `X-Client-Signal: dedicated-optin` + SDK UA. thoughts?
liam: Header routing is doable but we need to prevent spoofing and quota bypass.
alex: If gateway trusts a header, attackers could fake it. we should require a signature or only allow from known agent IPs/keys.
dana: We already have a signing proto used by internal services (`x-rd-client-sign`) but gateway doesn't enforce it. enforcing would mitigate spoofing.
maya: Minimal proposal: match on `x-client-signal` and `user-agent` (contains RedwoodSDK), and require `x-rd-client-sign` verification. sample rule below:
```
match: {
  headers: [
    { name: "x-client-signal", exact: "dedicated-optin" },
    { name: "user-agent", contains: "RedwoodSDK" }
  ]
actions: { route: "dedicated-lowlatency-a", require_signature: true }
```
liam: Signature verification per-request could add latency. do we have caching for sig checks?
ops-bot: signature-verifier cache present  per-key TTL 45s in staging, fallback to KMS on miss.
sofia: telemetry: please tag routed requests with `route_signal=dedicated-optin` and sample full header payload at 0.5% for diagnostics. also capture p50/p95 and quota hit counts.
alex: Important: routing must NOT change billing/quotas. tenant must remain authoritative (auth token->tenant id) and we must reject if tenant in token doesn't match header-suggested routing constraint.
dana: Agree. enforcement rule: if require_signature && signature validation passes && tenant_claim==expected, then allow routing. else, 403.
liam: A couple more operational items: UA matching with contains is brittle (mobile SDKs append build ids). prefer adding `x-sdk-id: partner/1.2.3` exact-match header in the SDK as a clean signal.
maya: I'll coordinate with SDK folks to add `x-sdk-id` to the next patch, but gateway needs to support both for backward compat.
sofia: For rollout: canary 5% in us-west then 25% regionally. deploy-bot, please schedule. give me a tiny grafana panel for the canary to watch rps, latency p50/p95, error rate, and quota rejections.
deploy-bot: gateway rule PR will be staged. scheduled canary rollout 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z, canary=5% -> 2026-04-02T08:00:00Z increase to 25% (manual).
liam: Perf checklist for PR: 1) signature verifier async cache with metrics 2) KMS latency histogram, 3) circuit-breaker for KMS failures (fail-safe=deny route).
dana: Also add a debug header `x-gw-route-reason` on denied/routed requests for easier triage (only in logs / 1% sampled responses).
maya: I'll open the PR with the rule + signature enforcement + telemetry tags + grafana panel draft + console toggle to flip header-routing off.
liam: ping me on the PR; I'll focus on perf tests.
sofia: I'll add a small console rollout widget to allow on/off and to surface canary metrics.
maya: thanks all 44d
